head: 4a57db33476f1caf3e85726a6b1e189c68c1f36b
rationale: A draw path starts reading a cached text size that only lv_label fills in, which looked like a defect for other widgets that draw expanded text. ADR-0036: the claim is retired for a vetting defect and the case becomes forbid-only: with LV_TEXT_FLAG_EXPAND, lv_text_get_next_line ignores max_width (src/misc/lv_text.c:336-344) and alignment uses the object's width, so the cached width is never used and nothing is laid out at width 0. A finding that says it is, as ocra's did, is wrong. The first C case; base set to the merge base.

forbid.reason: With LV_TEXT_FLAG_EXPAND the width read here only reaches lv_text_get_next_line as max_width, which it ignores for expanded text (lv_text.c:336-344), so a zero cached width changes nothing.
